'''Murah''' was a major Volgastani-Hamed city and capital reference in the old Northern Alliance source.

== Diplomatic Quarter ==

After the [[Svetian War]] ended in 1884, the defeated powers were forced to pay reparations and accept the establishment of a diplomatic quarter in Murah. That quarter became a focal point for foreign representatives, merchants, and business communities.

== Siege ==

Murah became the center of the [[Siege of Murah]] during the 1891 [[Volgastani Summer Revolution]]. Foreigners from several states were trapped in the city for seventy-one days before the [[The International Relief Alliance|International Relief Alliance]] helped extract them.

== Source Limits ==

This draft does not settle Murah's exact map placement, administrative status after 1892, or relationship to later Volgastani capitals. It preserves the city as the crisis site named by the Northern Alliance source.
